note: Both sets are heavily duplicated and share the same core facts (2500 g martensite pull force, 2900 g austenite pull force, 400 g total actuation force, 10 g max pull force per louver, 15–20C austenite range) and the same misread of the diagram (claiming an Austenite→Martensite deformation arrow that does not exist). Set A additionally captures the transformation temperature range correctly (200C to cryogenic, by Ni:Ti ratio) with a supporting quote, whereas Set B only states it reversed and once invents a '-200C' endpoint not in the source. Set A's clear errors are binding 10 grams to 'maximum friction' at the axial rotation points and to the shading system rather than the louver; Set B misbinds the 400 g total actuation force to the shading mechanism and fabricates the -200C value. On balance A covers the key temperature fact faithfully while B omits it, so A is slightly better.
